assertions.assertion: Bypassing either UI renderer still executes the same server-side C06 authorization before Product Core.
Private thread, run, file, memory, approval and citation items remain bound to the resolved Human Principal.
Cross-Tenant authorization evidence fails closed before private Core data is returned.
The identity BFF rejects raw bytes and only accepts a frozen command reference; the file result must remain Tenant-bound QUARANTINED.
Stream events are Tenant-, owner-, run- and sequence-bound and carry references rather than response bodies.
LibreChat adapter and minimal replacement renderer consume one BFF contract without moving authorization or approval truth.
Portal runtime contains no direct model, RAG, Connector, database or network path.
LibreChat is version-pinned only as an unevaluated reference and is not claimed as embedded, deployed, security-reviewed or production-approved.
